program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const isAtTop = t >= apexTime; const dropTime = isAtTop ? t - apexTime : 0; const dropVelocity = isAtTop ? -gravity * dropTime : 0; const dropAcceleration = isAtTop ? -gravity : 0; const dropHeight = isAtTop ? apexHeight - (gravity * dropTime * dropTime) / 2 : apexHeight; const tossState = t < 0.05 ? "At launch" : t < apexTime - 0.02 ? "Rising" : t <= apexTime + 0.02 ? "At the top" : tossedHeight > 0 ? "Falling" : "At launch height"; const dropState = t < apexTime - 0.02 ? "Held in place" : t <= apexTime + 0.02 ? "Just released" : dropHeight > 0 ? "Falling together" : "At launch height"; const scaleY = 120; const baseY = 320; const tossX = 200; const dropX = 440; const ballY = (h) => baseY - h * scaleY; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 60, y: 40, w: 260, h: 360, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 340, y: 40, w: 260, h: 360, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, ballY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)), 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, ballY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)), 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 25, y: ballY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)) }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 25, y: ballY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)) }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 25, y: ballY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)) }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 25, y: ballY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)) }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, label: "a" })); if (!isAtTop) { objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, ballY(apexHeight), { open: false, label: "Gate" })); } else { objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, ballY(apexHeight), { open: true, label: "Gate" })); } objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 45, ballY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)) - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 1) + " m/s²"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 45, ballY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)) - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 1) + " m/s²"], { id: "callout.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: tossX - 80, y: baseY, length: 264, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: dropX - 80, y: baseY, length: 264, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it. A second ball is released at that moment to compare.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. At the top of the toss, a gate releases the second ball, and both fall identically.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
